text:
rachel.sre: FYI we're running a multi-region failover rehearsal + autoscaler tuning on 2025-03-15 04:00-05:00 UTC. Purpose: verify graceful traffic shift, validate autoscaler cooldowns, and exercise the new traffic-shadowing feature. Internal doc: https://go/internal/failover-rehearsal.
ton.y.sre: small correction: it's `tony.sre` :)\rachel.sre: oops, thanks. Canaries: start staging->us-west at 03:50 UTC (shadowing), then failover simulation at 04:00 UTC to replicate 30% of prod traffic to failover pool for 20m.
leah.prod: Will this touch Dedicated reservations? Any risk to capacity guarantees?
carl.eng: Dedicated pools will not be drained; we'll route only a tiny percentage (shadow traffic) unless explicit opt-in. Reserve buckets used for rehearse are non-customer pools. No SLA changes.
synth-bot: Synthetic load generators scheduled -> job=syngen-20250315-04, targets=[us-east-1,us-west-2,eu-west-1], mode=shadow
deploy-bot: Autoscaler config update queued: profile=aggressive-burst-v2, cooldown=45s, scale-down-window=180s, initiator=rachel.sre
leah.prod: Can we exclude scheduled benchmark runs? There's a perf job in eu-west-1 at 04:10 that could skew results.
rachel.sre: Yes exclude `traffic-tag: perf-run` and any traffic with header `x-internal-test=true`. Add to calendar note.
ton.y.sre: Runbook (abbrev):
```
# Failover rehearsal runbook (abbrev)
T-30m: verify canary nodes healthy, ensure backup routing rules in place
T-10m: start shadowing to us-west (5% of traffic) -> monitor error-rate/1m and token-latency/p99
04:00 UTC: start failover simulation: shift 30% shadow traffic -> observe autoscaler and queue lengths
If error-rate > 1.5% above baseline for >5m -> pause job: `deploy-bot pause syngen-20250315-04` and rollback autoscaler profile
If autoscaler fails to scale (queue depth > 500k tokens for >3m) -> manual intervention: `scale group failover-pool +3` and escalate to runtime
Post-check: verify no residual routing entries and cancel shadowing job
```
pager: Alert suppression note: we'll mute p99 token and infra SLO alerts for maintenance window 04:00-04:40 UTC so the rehearsal doesn't trigger pages. This does not change SLA.
carl.eng: We'll also capture traces for a subset of requests for postmortem. If you want to observe live metrics, join the rehearsal bridge.
leah.prod: Quick ask: can we also exercise the new header-based routing fallback (x-failover-accept: true) so SDK teams can test client behavior?
rachel.sre: Good idea — we'll enable header on the canary path. SDK teams, please set that header if you're running smoke.
ton.y.sre: TL;DR: rehearsal 2025-03-15 04:00-05:00 UTC, shadowing + 30% failover sim, autoscaler profile swap, exclude perf runs, alert suppression in brief window. I'll post the bridge and tidy calendar invite.
leah.prod: ack :white_check_mark: I'll notify platform integrations and update the runbook link in the oncall doc.
carl.eng: I'll own postmortem notes and tail traces.
rachel.sre: Thanks all — ping here if you want to join the rehearsal or request exclusion.
